Runtime contract matches brief (integration.md l.3: server.js, port 3000, /api/health, env -i vars, DB_PATH, HOME not /app). Actual-run evidence (9 Oct 2026, cw-editor-verifier:current, --network none, --rm, scratch copy of frozen tests+solution, RewardKit replaced by a PATH stub so no provider spend): missing REWARDKIT env -> reward 0.0/no_op=1; missing server.js -> 0.0; /app/evil -> /etc/passwd symlink -> 0.0, no suite run; in-node_modules symlink accepted; server.js that exits -> 0.0 after liveness timeout (128 s wall, 120 probes), no suite run; golden app runs as 'nobody node /app/server.js', gates+scored pass -> 0.65 (0.6*0.5+0.2*1+0.2*0.75); gate failure -> 0.0000 detailed record, scored suite skipped; gates RewardKit crash -> plain zero; gates malformed JSON -> score.py exit 2 -> plain zero; scored crash -> 0.0 (gates-passed record, floors_passed 0); functional floor fail -> 0.0 with weighted 0.4; scored missing key -> plain zero; SIGTERM during hung scored suite -> rc 143, reward file present at 0.0000; app process group killed in every case. Adversarial: a dead app or one that answers nothing cannot reach RewardKit; an app answering 500 on /api/health passes liveness only (HTTPError treated as alive, template policy) and still has to pass judged gates. A conforming app needing >~2 min to boot would be zeroed, but the brief requires /api/health to answer even without a DB, so this is not a hidden requirement. Minor template-level observation (not a task defect, not to be patched here): after a gates pass, a scored-suite RewardKit failure leaves score.py's gates-only record (reward 0.0, graded 1) rather than the literal 'plain zero' in contract item 8; reward is still 0. Risk=true because a full configured verifier launch/grading with real RewardKit, claude-code judge and Playwright on these bytes is absent (raw-evidence-index scope says so); my runs prove the shell control flow and reward writing only, not a real judge launch.
